Yes—very likely.

Look roughly **southwest, about one-fifth of the way up from the horizon**. The illuminated portion will be a **crescent or gibbous crescent**, depending on the exact phase orientation, and it should be much brighter than the surrounding stars. Buildings, mountains, haze, or city light pollution could obstruct or reduce contrast, but under the stated conditions an ordinary observer should spot it easily.
